```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation version

on:
  schedule:
    # Run hourly to check for new releases
    - cron: '0 * * * *'

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get latest openinference-instrumentation release tag
        id: get_latest
        run: |
          TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Arize-ai/openinference-instrumentation/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          echo "latest_tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Read last processed tag
        id: read_last
        run: |
          if [ -f .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt ]; then
            LAST_TAG=$(cat .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt)
          else
            LAST_TAG=""
          fi
          echo "last_tag=$LAST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check if new release
        id: check_new_release
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}" != "${{ steps.read_last.outputs.last_tag }}" ]; then
            echo "is_new=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_new=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update dependencies
        if: steps.check_new_release.outputs.is_new == 'true'
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}
        run: |
          # Find all pyproject.toml files in instrumentor packages
          find . -type f -name 'pyproject.toml' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            # Update openinference-instrumentation dependency line
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation\s*>=\s*)[0-9.]+/\1${NEW_VERSION}/g" "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_new_release.outputs.is_new == 'true'
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Bump openinference-instrumentation to ${NEW_VERSION}"
          BRANCH="bump-openinference-instrumentation-${NEW_VERSION}"
          git push origin HEAD:"refs/heads/${BRANCH}"

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.check_new_release.outputs.is_new == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}
          base: main
          title: "Bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}"
          body: |
            This PR automatically bumps the minimum version of `openinference-instrumentation` to `${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.

      - name: Update last processed tag
        if: steps.check_new_release.outputs.is_new == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "${{ steps.get_latest.outputs.latest_tag }}" > .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/last_instrumentation_release.txt
          git commit -m "Update last processed openinference-instrumentation release tag"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
